 1. Component Assembly:
 Assemble electronic components and sub-assemblies according to engineering drawings, specifications, and work instructions.

 Manage and organize electronic components, ensuring proper storage and inventory control.

 7. Workstation Maintenance:
 Keep workstations clean, organized, and equipped with necessary tools and materials.
 Report any equipment malfunctions or maintenance needs promptly.

 Follow safety protocols and guidelines to ensure a safe working environment.

 Work collaboratively with team members and other departments to meet production goals and timelines.

Who we are 
 Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. 
 Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. 
 About the role 
 Join Samsara's In-Vehicle Experience team as a Senior Software Engineer. You'll be the technical leader of the team, setting the direction for what we build and how. We are building AI voice experiences that speak to, coach, and assist drivers as they work, spanning proactive assistance, on-demand interaction, and the range of situations in between. We are looking for the product-minded full-stack engineer who will figure out what those experiences should be, ship them, and build the systems that let them evolve into one coherent product rather than a set of disconnected tools.
 You'll design what agents say and how they behave, build the services that support them, and iterate on both based on what drivers actually experience. These systems sit at the intersection of software, AI, and the physical world. Because drivers interact with our products while operating a vehicle, decisions about what reaches them, and when, carry real weight. The systems underneath are where the hard-to-reverse decisions live. How agents share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, and how the system's decisions can be explained after the fact. You'll decide what's worth building, and own the systems that make it possible.
 You'll ship against clear priorities from day one. We are looking for someone whose instinct is to shape the direction of the team's work, not just execute against it. Putting forward a point of view, making the case for it, and getting the team moving in a new direction is core to how this person operates. Engineers who habitually notice what should improve and then make it happen, rather than waiting to be told, will find this kind of role familiar.
 AI-assisted engineering is central to this role. You will be expected to use tools such as Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor proficiently throughout the software development lifecycle, not only for code generation but also for investigation, design, testing, review, and operational work.
 This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Canada. 
 In this role, you will: 
 Define what to build and how to build it, shaping product direction from the engineering side.
 Build and ship voice agent experiences from zero to one in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment. Iterate quickly based on real interactions.
 Own the technical direction for how these experiences coordinate: how they share context, how concurrent interactions get arbitrated, how the system holds up as more experiences are added, and how its real-time decisions can be investigated by the teams that need to.
 Make and document architectural tradeoffs where requirements are still evolving, favoring foundations that generalize as new use cases emerge over one-off solutions that don't.
 Serve as the team's technical anchor: review designs, unblock decisions, and mentor engineers as they expand into unfamiliar technical domains.
 Introduce new patterns for full-stack and AI-assisted engineering, and get the team using them.
 Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.
 Minimum requirements for the role: 
 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of products from concept through production.
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 Recent, primary experience shipping LLM/agent based products end-to-end, including evaluation of AI behavior in production.
 Experience with memory, context, or retrieval systems for AI applications (e.g., RAG pipelines, vector databases, long-lived session context).
 Strong programming and design fundamentals (Go, TypeScript, Python).
 Experience designing APIs and service boundaries that other systems rely on.
 Experience setting technical direction on a team and mentoring other engineers.
 Strong communication skills and the ability to influence technical direction without formal authority.
 Located in and authorized to work in the United States or Canada (this is a fully remote role).
 An ideal candidate also has: 
 Experience building zero-to-one products in fast-moving, high-autonomy environments.
 Experience building persistent memory or personalization systems where agents learn about users over time.
 Experience with multi-agent orchestration: coordinating multiple agents, avoiding conflicts, and maintaining consistency.
 Experience building scheduling or arbitration systems.
 Experience designing systems that combine structured and open-ended signal collection to inform product decisions.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!


ROLE OVERVIEW:

As a Business Development Representative (BDR) at Cohere, you will drive revenue growth by identifying, qualifying, and nurturing high-potential leads for our enterprise AI solutions. You’ll act as the first point of contact for prospects, understanding their business needs and aligning them with Cohere’s products to solve complex challenges like natural language processing, AI integration, and scalable language models. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell cutting-edge IP, that is being newly productised, within your own book of business.

 - Proactively research and identify target accounts across region in industries such as finance, technology, manufacturing, healthcare, public sector, etc. using tools like LinkedIn Sales Navigator and CRM platforms to prioritise high-fit prospects.

 - Collaborate with marketing to refine messaging and campaigns based on prospect feedback, contributing to a 15%+ improvement in campaign response rates.

 - Stay updated on industry trends, competitor offerings, and Cohere’s product roadmap to position our solutions effectively and anticipate customer needs.

 - Run independent sales cycles on smaller opportunities with less overhead, from intro to close.

 - 2+ years of experience in business development, sales, or a related role, with a proven track record of exceeding lead generation targets in a SaaS or tech environment.

 - Strong communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and build rapport quickly over phone and email.

 - Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales enablement platforms, with the ability to analyse data to optimize outreach strategies.

 - Experience in AI, machine learning, or enterprise software sales, with a basic understanding of natural language processing (NLP) concepts.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

 Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round.

 Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify)
 Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam)

 Amélioration des processus et des leçons apprises 
 Contribuer à l'harmonisation des processus, des modèles et des listes de contrôle des appels d'offres pour l'ensemble des projets.

THE ROLE

Financial software runs underneath the biggest decisions people make. When it's good, it saves real money over the years. When it's not, those losses compound just as quietly. Most of it was built to capture value, not create it. Neo is building the alternative.

As a Senior / Staff  React Native Developer, you will own the  experience that millions of Canadians interact with daily. We don't build wrappers or standard CRUD apps; we build ultra-responsive, highly secure, and visually flawless mobile experiences from the ground up. You will set the technical direction for our React Native architecture, bridge the gap between JS and native modules when performance demands it, and mentor engineers who are obsessed with shipping world-class code.

Our engineering teams are small by design. You'll work closely with product and design to turn complex financial mechanics into seamless, high-performance interactions.




WHY NEO

 - Small teams with real ownership: You are not managing a function inside a function. You own your services and clients end-to-end—from architecture decisions and schema design through to production. There is no separate QA or DevOps team to hand work off to; the autonomy to execute is entirely yours.

 - World-class toolset: No compromises on tooling. We treat cutting-edge tech and AI as force multipliers. You get full access to Cursor, Claude with unlimited tokens, CodeRabbit, GitHub Enterprise, Datadog, Snowflake, and AWS. MacBook Pros are standard issue—no justification required.

 - Top-tier compensation: Competitive salaries that beat the top tech companies in Canada. This role is eligible for our Short-Term Incentive Program (STIP) with cash bonuses tied directly to company milestones.

 - Generous equity: All team members receive equity through stock options that are in the money from day one. Over four to five years, total compensation at Neo outpaces what you’d make staying where you are.

 - Unmatched career velocity: Engineers at Neo should be able to walk into a lead or management role at any company in Canada after serious time here. That’s the standard we hold.

 - Proven hyper-growth: Three consecutive years as Canada’s fastest-growing company on the Deloitte Technology Fast 50™. We have raised $400M+ and serve over one million customers on a platform built entirely in-house.

 - Relocation & Benefits: Full relocation support is available for candidates moving to Calgary. We provide comprehensive health benefits from day one, 21 days PTO, and a maternity/paternity leave salary top-up.

 - Top-rated experiences: Our platform is consistently high-rated on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store, reflecting our commitment to quality and user satisfaction.




WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

 - Architect & Scale: Design, build, and maintain robust, scalable frontend applications using React Native for iOS, Android, and Web.

 - DX Tooling: Improve and maintain developer experience tooling to ensure our engineering teams can ship high-quality code at speed.

 - Drive Performance: Optimize app performance, render times, and memory leaks. You know how to thread native code (Swift/Kotlin) into the React Native ecosystem when JavaScript hits a bottleneck.

 - Ship End-to-End: Write clean, modular, and highly testable code. You own your features from initial architectural design through deployment to the App Store and Google Play.

 - Technical Leadership: Set the standard for mobile engineering excellence. You will lead technical design reviews, champion automated testing (unit, integration, and e2e), and mentor junior/intermediate developers.

 - Minimize Friction: Help optimize processes. Stay close enough to the codebase to maintain absolute technical credibility while operating at a strategic level.




WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

 - The Experience: You have at least 7 years of software engineering experience, with a heavy emphasis on building and scaling complex production mobile applications.

 - The Tech Stack: You have deep, production-proven expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native. Familiarity with native mobile development (iOS/Swift or Android/Kotlin) is highly valued2.

 - Architecture Mindset: You understand state management at scale, mobile security best practices (storage, biometrics, cryptography), and how to build resilient offline-first or highly cached experiences.

 - High Ownership: You care about the product, not just the code. You have a track record of shipping beautiful consumer experiences and iterating based on real-world data.

 - On-Site Collaboration: You thrive in a high-intensity, high-growth environment and are excited to collaborate in person daily at our Calgary headquarters.




🚀 TOTAL REWARDS

As Neo continues to grow, we’re committed to offering a competitive, market-leading rewards program that reflects the impact our team members make. In addition to salary, our program includes equity — empowering employees to share directly in our momentum today and in the meaningful value we create for years to come.

 - Salary: We provide a strong base salary aligned with market ranges, along with the flexibility to tailor your mix of cash and equity to match your longer term goals. Final compensation is based on your skills, experience, and scope. For exceptional talent, we’re prepared to go above and beyond.

 - Equity Ownership (Where Eligible): At Neo, you don’t just work here, you own a piece of what we’re building. As a full-time team member, you share directly in the upside of one of Canada’s fastest-growing companies. When we win, you win — with real ownership and meaningful long-term wealth-building potential tied to our success.

 


WHAT DOES LIFE AS AN OWNER AT NEO INCLUDE?

🇨🇦 You will redefine the financial landscape with top talent in Canada to help everyday Canadians win, and grow quickly while doing it

📈 For eligible roles, ownership structure that enables you to share in our path to victory

🏅Earn BIG with our short term incentive plans (STIP)

👥 Collaborating with the brightest minds to build something meaningful, united by a shared commitment to innovation, curiosity, and excellence

❤️‍🩹 Flexible health benefits & life insurance

🌴 21 Days PTO + stat holidays, and personal leave

💪 Health & personal spending accounts

🤑 A wide variety of discounts through our partner network

🏠 Access to early use of products and discounts on fixed-term Neo mortgages

👶 Parental top-up & equity vesting during long term leave

🎉 Neo night events

🧠 Company wide huddles, and education




WORKING AT NEO:

The people who thrive at Neo are resourceful, growth-oriented, and driven to win. We hold ourselves to high standards because we’re on a mission that matters: to build a more rewarding financial future for all Canadians. As individuals and as a team, we constantly challenge ourselves and each other to raise the bar and deliver exceptional experiences for our customers. Our commitment to customer success drives everything we do, from building world-class products to providing exceptional support at every step of their journey. If this resonates with you, keep reading. 



We trust, respect, and support each other. This means honest conversations, constructive input, and empowering each other to move fast and think big. You’ll be surrounded by people who push you to be your best. We primarily collaborate in person across our Calgary, Winnipeg, and Toronto offices, where ideas move quickly and teams build momentum together. As we continue to scale and evolve, we’re looking for builders, innovators, and problem solvers who thrive on challenge–people who would rather blaze a trail through uncertainty than follow a well-paved path. 



At Neo, ownership is part of how we think and operate. For select roles, equity participation reinforces that mindset by giving employees a direct stake in the company’s long-term success. Regardless of role, every team member is expected to think like an owner and make decisions that move the business forward.




APPLY WITH US:

À propos de Mila 
 Fondé par le professeur Yoshua Bengio de l’Université de Montréal, Mila rassemble des chercheurs spécialisés en intelligence artificielle et plus précisément en apprentissage automatique, apprentissage profond et apprentissage par renforcement. Reconnu mondialement pour ses importantes contributions au domaine de l’apprentissage profond, Mila s’est particulièrement distingué dans la modélisation du langage, la traduction automatique, la reconnaissance d’objets et les modèles génératifs. Depuis 2017, Mila est le fruit d’une collaboration entre l’Université de Montréal et l’Université McGill, en lien étroit avec Polytechnique Montréal et HEC Montréal.
 Mila s’est donné pour mission d’être un pôle mondial d’avancées scientifiques qui inspire l’innovation et l’essor de l’intelligence artificielle (IA) au bénéfice de tous.
 Pour en connaitre davantage, veuillez consulter https://mila.quebec/ 
 Description du mandat: 
 Relevant de la responsable de l'expérience en apprentissage et développement, vous veillerez à la coordination fluide des activités et contribuerez à la prestation des programmes d'apprentissage et de développement qui soutiennent les membres de notre écosystème dans leur croissance et leur développement. Vous jouerez un rôle clé pour assurer l'excellence de nos activités en présentiel, en ligne et asynchrones en prenant en charge les opérations quotidiennes, en coordonnant avec les partenaires internes et externes, et en assurant les suivis nécessaires.
 Fonctions et responsabilités: 
 Coordination des formations
 Coordonner la planification et la prestation des séances de formation, des ateliers et des programmes d'apprentissage, tant en présentiel qu'en virtuel.
 Coordonner les participant·e·s aux programmes d'apprentissage et de développement (ex. : création de formulaires d'inscription, gestion des listes de diffusion et des inscriptions, rédaction et gestion des communications avec les participant·e·s avant, pendant et après la séance ou le programme, création et analyse de formulaires d'évaluation).
 Soutenir les facilitateurs·trices et les responsables de programmes dans la logistique avant, pendant et après les séances.
 Liaison avec les fournisseurs
 Agir en tant que point de contact principal pour les fournisseurs externes, facilitateurs·trices et prestataires de services désignés.
 Gérer les communications quotidiennes et confirmer la portée et les échéanciers.
 Aider à établir et à nourrir des relations solides et collaboratives avec nos partenaires.
 Activités hors site et événements
 Planifier et coordonner de bout en bout les activités hors site, les retraites et les événements d'apprentissage, y compris la recherche de lieux, le service traiteur, l'audiovisuel et les besoins d'accessibilité.
 Anticiper les détails et s'adapter avec calme lorsque les plans changent.
 Administration des programmes
 Configurer et mettre à jour les informations relatives aux programmes sur les différentes plateformes numériques utilisées, y compris notre système de gestion de l'apprentissage (LMS), et assurer la bonne transmission du contenu aux différentes parties prenantes.
 Gérer l'inscription des participant·e·s, le suivi des présences et les communications de suivi.
 Diffuser des sondages pré- et post-programme, compiler les résultats et partager les observations avec l'équipe.
 Maintenir à jour une base de données des lieux externes, des emplacements et des fournisseurs, incluant la capacité, la tarification, les contacts et les commentaires antérieurs.

 Join Us in Shaping the Future
At Intel, we are building the next generation of software technologies that unlock the potential of heterogeneous computing. Our compiler technologies help developers harness CPUs, GPUs, and accelerators through high-performance, portable software. The Team
The Intel Compiler Engineering Team develops LLVM-based C, C++, SYCL, Triton, MLIR, Domain Specific Languages (DSLs), and Fortran compiler technologies for Intel processor platforms, including CPUs and GPUs. The team works across the compiler stack and in close collaboration with hardware architecture teams, covering language front ends, intermediate representations, optimization, code generation, debug information, runtimes, offload support, quality, and developer tooling. This work connects Intel hardware and compiler capabilities with AI frameworks and software ecosystems such as PyTorch, inference engines, and machine-learning models. You will collaborate with experienced engineers and contribute to open-source communities while learning how production compilers are designed, tested, optimized, and delivered.

We are hiring a Compiler Engineer Intern to contribute to Intel's compiler software stack. À PROPOS DE CARRUS 
 Carrus conçoit le logiciel de gestion sur lequel les distributeurs de pièces automobiles, les grossistes et les ateliers de réparation de l’Est du Canada s’appuient pour gérer leurs activités — des catalogues électroniques de pièces et de la tarification à l’inventaire, à la facturation et à la comptabilité. Depuis 2002, Carrus sert le marché secondaire de l’automobile avec un logiciel sur lequel ses clients comptent chaque jour au comptoir.
 Carrus est un excellent milieu de travail si vous souhaitez avoir une réelle autonomie sur le fonctionnement d’une équipe et un travail dont les clients ressentent l’impact le jour même. Carrus fait partie de l’écosystème de Valsoft, qui regroupe plus de 150 entreprises de logiciels verticaux, ce qui vous offre la stabilité et les ressources de l’une des entreprises à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, dans l’ambiance d’une équipe ciblée et tissée serré.
 LE POSTE 
 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un ou d’une chef d’équipe bilingue, Soutien à la clientèle, pour diriger au quotidien l’équipe de soutien de Carrus. Si vous aimez résoudre des problèmes avec les clients au téléphone, accompagner les personnes qui vous entourent et assumer la responsabilité des résultats d’une équipe, ce poste est fait pour vous.
 Vous serez responsable d’améliorer de façon autonome notre système de soutien. Vous travaillerez à cerner et à mettre en œuvre des améliorations aux processus et aux flux de travail afin d’assurer la réactivité de l’équipe et la satisfaction de la clientèle, tout en étant encouragé(e) à automatiser les goulots d’étranglement sans compromettre les normes de service. Vous serez responsable de la formation et du mentorat d’une équipe de service à la clientèle, en l’aidant à améliorer et à prioriser les files d’attente et les flux de travail pour un rendement optimal. Vous apprendrez notre pile technologique et bâtirez des relations avec la clientèle, en étant en mesure de traiter et de résoudre de façon autonome les problèmes et les escalades des clients.
 Vous relèverez du directeur, Produit et Soutien, et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Développement et Intégration des clients. Vous prendrez en charge les revues quotidiennes de la file d’attente et le suivi des indicateurs de performance clés (IPC) de l’équipe, puis bâtirez le guide de soutien à partir de là : la base de connaissances, les guides d’exploitation, les modèles de réponse ainsi que les flux de travail et les ententes de niveau de service (SLA) dans Jira qui permettent de faire avancer la file d’attente.
 Vous vous épanouirez dans ce rôle si vous restez calme sous pression, prêchez par l’exemple et préférez régler la cause profonde d’un problème plutôt que de résoudre deux fois le même billet. Vous serez évalué(e) selon des indicateurs quantifiables sur lesquels vous avez une influence directe : l’arriéré de billets, le délai moyen de résolution, la satisfaction de la clientèle et les délais de réponse.
 CE QUE VOUS FEREZ 
 Élaborer et améliorer continuellement les processus et les flux de travail de l’organisation en matière de gestion des billets de soutien, de la collecte et du suivi des données clés pour les IPC jusqu’à l’élaboration de guides d’automatisation.
 Accompagner et encadrer une équipe d’agents de soutien sur les pratiques exemplaires afin d’augmenter les taux de résolution des billets et la satisfaction de la clientèle.
 Diriger l’équipe au quotidien — assurer la couverture pendant les heures d’ouverture, animer les rencontres quotidiennes et les rencontres individuelles, et établir et incarner la norme en matière de résolution rapide et rigoureuse.
 Prendre en charge une partie de la file de billets, particulièrement les problèmes hautement prioritaires — répondre aux appels et aux demandes entrants en français et en anglais.
 Trier et prioriser la file d’attente avec l’équipe de soutien afin que les problèmes urgents soient réglés en premier, et maintenir l’arriéré et les délais de réponse dans les cibles convenues.
 Faire remonter les bogues aux équipes Produit et Développement avec des détails clairs et reproductibles, et en assurer le suivi jusqu’à leur résolution.
 Diriger les communications avec la clientèle lors de pannes, de versions problématiques ou d’autres escalades, et mener le suivi par la suite ou veiller à ce que l’équipe en assume la responsabilité de façon appropriée.
 Élaborer, en collaboration avec les développeurs et les responsables de produit, la base de connaissances, et créer et tenir à jour les guides d’exploitation internes et les modèles de réponse.
 Assumer la configuration de Jira Service Management, y compris les catégories, les flux de travail et les SLA.
 Collaborer avec l’équipe d’Intégration des clients pour assurer une transition fluide vers le soutien pour chaque nouveau client.
 Faire le suivi du rendement de l’équipe et des principaux facteurs du volume de billets, et en rendre compte au directeur général.
 Traiter les problèmes de soutien impliquant des clients par l’intermédiaire de leurs partenaires informatiques et des fournisseurs technologiques de Carrus.
 CE QUE NOUS RECHERCHONS 
 3 ans et plus d’expérience en soutien de logiciels B2B, dont au moins 2 ans à diriger ou à superviser officiellement une équipe de soutien.
 Un historique d’améliorations mesurables, comme la réduction de l’arriéré, l’augmentation de la satisfaction de la clientèle (CSAT) ou la diminution des billets récurrents.
 Maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral.
 Expérience dans un environnement de soutien téléphonique ou de centre d’appels, en soutien de logiciels essentiels aux activités comme des systèmes ERP, de point de vente (PDV), de gestion des stocks ou de gestion de concessionnaires ou d’ateliers.
 Solides compétences pratiques en dépannage touchant les installations, les environnements hébergés, les autorisations des utilisateurs, le matériel de point de vente et les imprimantes, ainsi que les notions de base en réseautique.
 Expérience de la configuration et de la gestion d’une plateforme de billetterie comme Jira Service Management, Zendesk ou Freshdesk.
 Communication calme et claire, tant avec le personnel de comptoir mécontent qu’avec les propriétaires d’entreprise.
 Autonomie et capacité à diriger efficacement une équipe en télétravail.
 Atouts 
 Expérience dans le marché secondaire de l’automobile, par exemple dans la distribution de pièces, chez un distributeur-entrepositaire ou chez un fournisseur de systèmes de gestion d’ateliers (JMS).
 Connaissance des intégrations avec les fournisseurs, de l’EDI et des données de catalogues électroniques de pièces.
 Connaissances de base en SQL pour enquêter sur les problèmes de données.

 Instacart’s Logistics Product team owns the multi-sided fulfillment engine that powers every order on the platform. We deliver fast and affordable delivery and pickup for customers; flexible, reliable, and competitive earnings for shoppers; and continuously improving efficiency and quality for the marketplace as a whole. Logistics runs on ML and optimization at its core — how we batch orders, match them to shoppers, position and pay shoppers for their work, and route them physically — making this one of the most technically deep and commercially consequential product areas at Instacart.

 Content people save and share – saves, shares and engagement rate by brand (platform insights)

 Turn the creator and UGC content from our creator programs into organic posts that perform.

 Read the data every week and act on it: double down on what works and drop what doesn't.

 Native-level written English
 Hands-on Organic Social: 2+ years personally running organic social for a DTC or consumer brand – creating and publishing the content yourself, not just approving it or managing an agency.

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.
 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.
 Customer Experience at Brex 
 The Customer Experience team is the connective tissue between Brex’s product and the companies that depend on it every day. We don’t just resolve issues — we surface insights, close feedback loops, and help shape the product roadmap. As Brex becomes an AI-native company, our CX organization leads that shift: building the systems, metrics, and workflows that let AI handle routine complexity while humans focus on judgment and relationships. We measure success not by tickets closed, but by customers who don’t need to contact us in the first place.
 What you’ll do 
 Brex is looking for an experienced AI operator & leader to own the strategy and execution of AI-powered customer experience. You’ll lead the team responsible for Brex’s AI customer service platform — optimizing instruction sets, driving quality, and expanding AI across chat, voice, and email. You’ll also own the internal side of the equation: building and deploying AI-powered tools that give Brex’s CX team a measurable productivity edge — from agent-assist and real-time guidance to QA automation and workflow tooling. You’ll own the metrics that matter on both sides, define what “great” looks like for AI performance, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap. This is not a research or strategy-deck role. You’ll build, ship, and iterate on systems that make Brex’s CX the best support on the planet — and lead the team that makes it happen.
 Where you’ll work 
 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home.  Lead the CX Strategy team, setting direction, developing team members, and aligning priorities to CX and company goals.

 Own the CX AI roadmap from opportunity discovery through implementation — prioritize where AI can improve efficiency and customer experience, and sequence investments that compound over time.
 Collaborate with Systems and Engineering to drive CX AI performance — instruction set optimization, channel expansion (chat, voice, email), containment quality, and escalation handling, etc.
 Internal AI tools & team productivity

 Partner with Engineering, Data, and Product Ops to build and maintain the AI infrastructure underneath these tools — knowledge reliability, shared workflows, and feedback loops that improve both customer-facing and internal AI systems over time.

 Here’s the fun part: we’re not building another portal. We’re building a programmable back office. An expense lands in an inbox and gets coded to the right entity and staged for approval.  SQL Traffic Replay Tooling , which validates upgrades and changes against real production workloads.
 PostgreSQL as a Service Platform , which provides standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management for internal product databases.
 PostgreSQL Major Version Upgrade Automation , which supports safe, repeatable major upgrades at GitLab.com scale.
 What you’ll do
 Design, build, and maintain Go-based automation that manages the full PostgreSQL lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, upgrades, failover, scaling, and decommissioning, reducing reactive operational work that currently takes more than 80% of the team's time.
 Build automation that works across infrastructure-as-code tooling and cloud infrastructure, and evaluate operator-based approaches as the platform evolves.
 Use AI agents as a regular part of building and operating services, including implementation, review, and reducing repetitive work, while keeping the context agents need in the repository so the whole team can build on it.
 Build for internet scale by designing automation and services for high-throughput, always-on production workloads, where GitLab.com traffic sets the bar for correctness, latency, and availability.
 Integrate compute, storage, networking, identity and access management, and managed data services across cloud providers into one coherent PostgreSQL platform instead of creating bespoke setups for each database.
 Build GitLab's PostgreSQL as a service platform to replace bespoke database setups with standardized, automated provisioning and lifecycle management, so supporting more databases doesn't require growing the operations team at the same rate.
 Collaborate closely with product management, infrastructure, software delivery, and other engineering teams to design and ship high-performing solutions.

 Document automation practices, PostgreSQL operational patterns, and guidance that helps engineers use and contribute to the platform.
 Build safe, repeatable automation for PostgreSQL major version upgrades at GitLab.com scale, validating changes against real production traffic before rollout.
 Operate what you build in production from end to end, using production feedback to guide each iteration.
 What you’ll bring
 Professional software engineering experience working with PostgreSQL in large, complex production environments, including experience building or operating a database-as-a-service product.
 Proficiency with Go, including designing, implementing, testing, and reviewing backend services.
 Experience developing Kubernetes operators, controllers, or similar automation for the lifecycle of stateful services, especially databases.  Comfort with infrastructure as code and core database operations concepts such as high availability, replication, backups, and system-level performance trade-offs.

 Strong written communication skills and comfort working asynchronously in an all-remote, distributed team.

The Product Support Specialist will:

 - Respond to inquiries that encompass the entire Jobber ecosystem from new and existing customers through live chat, phone, or email.

 - Troubleshoot issues or problem solve questions that customers may have about a feature, bug, or work flow. 

 - Maintain high channel productivity across our different mediums.

 - Be a liaison for customer feedback to product and technical teams.

 - Build a knowledge base of FAQ’s and document all feedback and recommendations from our customers, ensuring the integrity of that data to help shape future decisions.

To be successful, you should:

 - Have 1 year of contact centre experience, preferred.

 - Be agile and adaptable to solve problems quickly. We’re growing fast and things are changing every day - both in our product and in our process. You need to be invigorated by this type of environment and be excited by a new challenge.

 - Be empathetic to our customers' journeys. Our biggest priority is to support our customers, so you need to be comfortable and confident diving into their issues and fill in your own knowledge gaps to better support them.

 - Be clear and effective in interactions with our customers over the phone. You should be confident in your verbal communication skills, being able to articulate information concisely and with a friendly demeanor will be crucial in addressing customer needs and resolving issues promptly.

 - Be able to craft professional and empathetic responses to customer inquiries via email and chat. Attention to detail and clarity in your writing will ensure our customers receive accurate and helpful information in every interaction.

 - Be curious. Asking questions and probing is essential in this role, and the key to being able to provide great customer service.

 - Be incredibly reliable for our customers and the rest of the success team. Being supportive is one of our company values, so showing up for your team and customers is number one. 

 - Be resilient in the face of adversity. Not every problem will be simple to solve and not every customer interaction will be a positive one. Being able to overcome those moments and learn from them for next time is key. 

 - Be confident with technology. You should be able to touch type to help you get through high-volume chats and be very comfortable navigating cloud-based software.

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.

Compensation:

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a minimum annual salary of $50,000, a midpoint of $58,800, and a maximum salary of $67,600, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire’s skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers between the minimum to the midpoint reflect strong potential with transferable work experience. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual’s current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You’ll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we’re happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!



The Interview Process: 

Step 1: We’ll review your application! The candidates whose customer service experience aligns with the role will be moved forward in the process. We're looking for problem solvers, and people used to working in a fast-paced and multi-tasking environment. Make sure to highlight this one your application!  

Step 2: AI interview! Candidates moving forward will receive a link to complete a brief, AI interview through Metaview.

Step 3: Initial convo with TA! A member of Talent Attraction will reach out to you for a first conversation. We want you to share your unique story and experience, and see how you’ll help drive us forward. This is also a great opportunity to ask questions about Jobber and the role! 

Step 4: Team Interviews!  You’ll have two interviews with your potential team leader and peers to dig into your previous experience and performance, as well as to see your skill set in action in a Customer Support role play. We’re constantly raising our bar and excited to see what you can bring to Jobber.

Step 5: Offer!

What you can expect from Jobber:

 - A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.

 - To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh*t about our customers.

We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

 Job Description: 
 Western Colorado University invites applications for a full-time, tenure-track faculty position in Finance in the School of Business. We seek a dynamic teacher-scholar who is committed to excellent undergraduate teaching, student-centered learning, professional preparation, and applied, career-connected education. This is an in-person, on-campus position on Western’s vibrant residential campus in Gunnison, Colorado.
 Finance is central to business education and to understanding how organizations, industries, and economies create, allocate, and sustain value. At Western, finance connects across our curriculum and distinctive areas of study—from the experience economy and energy industry to economics, entrepreneurship, real estate, and the broader business disciplines—providing students with the financial knowledge and analytical capabilities essential to informed decision-making and effective leadership.
 The successful candidate will join the School of Business at an exciting time of growth and innovation and will contribute broadly to finance education across our programs. An important component of this growth is the development of a new Certified Financial Planner (CFP) educational pathway designed to prepare students for careers in financial planning and related financial services fields.
 We especially welcome candidates who can contribute expertise in areas such as financial planning, investments, portfolio management, retirement planning, insurance, estate planning, taxation, personal finance, corporate finance, or related areas of finance.
 The standard teaching load is 24 credit hours per academic year. The successful candidate will teach undergraduate finance courses and other courses aligned with their expertise and School needs. The successful candidate will also have the opportunity to collaborate with School of Business faculty and external partners in the development and implementation of Western’s new CFP curriculum and its alignment with CFP Board educational requirements.
 Western values faculty who connect classroom learning with professional practice. The successful candidate will have opportunities to engage students through applied learning experiences such as internships, investment and financial analysis projects, community-based learning, research, case competitions, industry partnerships, and other career-connected learning opportunities. Faculty may also participate in Western’s innovative Western Watershed General Education program and First-Year Seminar Headwaters courses.
 The School of Business serves more than 325 students across its majors and minors. Students can earn degrees in Business Administration and Economics, with emphases including energy management, finance, management, and marketing. Our programs combine rigorous academic preparation with applied learning, close faculty mentorship, industry engagement, and opportunities for students to bridge theory and practice.
 The School is expanding opportunities in finance through curricular innovation, professional and industry partnerships, community engagement, and applied learning. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to help shape this growth and contribute to preparing students for careers across financial planning, investment management, banking, corporate finance, entrepreneurship, and other areas in which financial knowledge and decision-making are essential.
 Western supports its faculty by fostering a collaborative and innovative academic community. Our Teaching and Learning Center (TLC) engages faculty, staff, and administrators in cross-campus initiatives designed to strengthen teaching and learning through diverse expertise, innovation, and continuous improvement. The Professional Activity Fund (PAF) provides financial support for faculty engaged in research, conference participation, grant writing, professional development, and other scholarly or creative activities, with three application opportunities each year.
 Western’s faculty are teacher-scholars who contribute meaningfully to their disciplines, the University, our community, and beyond. We seek candidates who will actively support Western’s institutional mission and strategic priorities, including:
 Delivering rigorous, engaging, and student-centered undergraduate education
 Participating in Western’s innovative Western Watershed General Education program
 Promoting student success, wellness, inclusion, and belonging
 Collaborating within and across disciplines to grow enrollment and deepen student engagement
 Expanding applied and career-connected learning and professional pathways
 Building relationships with employers, alumni, industry partners, and professional organizations
 Contributing through teaching, scholarship, advising, service, and engagement to the continued growth of the School of Business
 Learn more about the department at: https://western.edu/department/school-of-business/ 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Required Qualifications:
 A Ph.D. or equivalent terminal degree in Finance, Financial Planning, Business Administration with a finance concentration, or a closely related field is required. ABD candidates will be considered for appointment, with completion of the terminal degree required for tenure.

 A commitment to excellence in undergraduate teaching and student-centered education
 Academic preparation to teach finance and related courses at the undergraduate level
 Potential for continued scholarship, research, professional engagement, or other scholarly activity appropriate to the discipline
 A commitment to advising, mentoring, and supporting students from a broad range of backgrounds and educational experiences
 An ability to integrate technology and contemporary financial tools into instruction
 An ability and willingness to teach in multiple instructional modalities, including in-person, online, and hybrid formats
 A willingness to contribute to university and professional service
 Collegiality, collaboration, and professional flexibility

 Teaching and/or professional expertise in one or more areas of finance, including investments, corporate finance, financial planning, portfolio management, personal finance, banking, real estate finance, or related fields
 Professional or industry experience that strengthens the connection between finance education and contemporary business practice
 Experience developing innovative courses, curricula, certificates, academic programs, or interdisciplinary learning opportunities
 Experience building partnerships with financial institutions, businesses, professional organizations, employers, alumni, or community organizations
 Experience incorporating applied learning, financial technology, data analytics, artificial intelligence, simulations, case studies, or industry projects into finance education

ABOUT THIS ROLE

You will help us win Enterprise accounts in Pacific and Mountain time zones by managing the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to won. You can expect to own a curated list of excellent fit, high propensity accounts as well as a geographic territory with significant market opportunity.

In this role, you'll primarily focus on new logo acquisition via a healthy mix of inbound and outbound, while also covering a small number of customer accounts for expansion and upsell. Our emphasis is on your ability to excel in the areas listed below and your appetite for continuous growth & improvement.

 


ROLE REQUIREMENTS:

 - You have a multi-year track record of exceeding $1M+ quotas, selling complex SaaS technologies to large organizations

 - You have closed many $100K+ ARR sales which require consensus building and executive engagement.

 - You have a demonstrated ability to win highly competitive opportunities by identifying pain and business impacts and connecting those to strategic initiatives of the leadership team

 - 🤝 You have strong business acumen. You help customers connect the dots between technical problems and their business impact. You craft compelling cases for change.

 - 💰 You're excited to land the biggest deals we've ever done. You are diligent and gritty and have demonstrated perseverance to win long, competitive sales cycles.

 - ✈️ You're willing to travel for company events, customer meet ups and on-sites. 

 


YOU MAY NOT BE A GREAT FIT IF:

BONUS:

 - Familiarity with Talent Acquisition and HR tools and workflows

 - A network that includes Heads of Talent whom you can tap into
   
    


INTERVIEW PROCESS
